claims: NASA has launched the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission sends four astronauts on a 10-day crewed journey around the moon.
The Artemis II mission departs on April 1, 2026, from Florida.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA astronaut on board the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover is a NASA astronaut on board the Artemis II mission.
Christina Koch is a NASA astronaut on board the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency astronaut on board the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission will not land on the moon.
The Artemis II mission will perform a flyby.
The Artemis II mission will test the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission will test the Orion capsule.
A future landing is scheduled for 2028.
The Artemis II mission will take the crew around the far side of the moon.
The Artemis II mission will go over 230,000 miles from Earth.
The Artemis II mission enables the first woman to fly to the moon.
The Artemis II mission enables the first Black astronaut to fly to the moon.
The Artemis II mission enables the first non-U.S. citizen to fly to the moon.
